description: Render a MyPivots Daily Notes candlestick chart PNG image for a single namespaced symbol and optional calendar date. Returns a 1440×810 PNG image block showing historical OHLCV candlesticks, moving averages, volume, and pivot point overlays (using the caller's saved MyPivots chart preferences when available, or MyPivots defaults, with optional rangePreset and timeframe overrides), followed by a text summary containing the symbol, tradingDate rendered, closing price, Classic pivot point, and canonical Daily Note URL. When date is omitted, the chart renders through the latest available trading day. Semantics mirror daily_notes_query: an unrecognized symbol or a date before the symbol's recorded history returns a text-only response with status "missing" and a reason instead of failing the call; a date that falls on a non-trading day (weekend or exchange holiday) renders the nearest prior trading day, labeled by its tradingDate in the text summary. Requests with malformed symbols, invalid dates, unsupported overrides, or unknown properties fail with an error and return nothing. Use for visual historical, end-of-day chart analysis of a specific symbol and date; it does not provide real-time quotes, intraday ticks, forecasts, or trading. Calls require a MyPivots Premium subscription or partner key.

date.description: Optional calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-09-24"). Defaults to the latest available trading day when omitted. A date that falls on a non-trading day renders the nearest prior trading day, labeled by its tradingDate; a date before a symbol's recorded history returns a missing-status text response.

rangePreset.description: Optional visible range window override ("1M", "3M", "6M", or "All"). Overrides the member's saved chart settings when provided; omit to use saved settings or the default 30-period window.

symbol.description: Namespaced symbol string: "stk:" stocks and ETFs, "fut:" futures, "idx:" indices, "fx:" or "forex:" currency pairs, "crypto:" crypto pairs (e.g. "stk:AAPL", "fut:ES", "fut:NQZ26", "idx:VIX", "fx:EURUSD", "crypto:BTCUSD"). An unrecognized symbol does not fail the call; it returns a text-only missing-status response with a reason.

timeframe.description: Optional candlestick timeframe override ("daily", "weekly", or "monthly"). Overrides the member's saved chart settings when provided; omit to use saved settings or the default daily timeframe.
